ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white (approximately 85% of surface) vs low-intensity black (approximately 15% of surface) concentrated on margins and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central region; solid black perimeter bands along the entire trailing edge and tips; isolated dark focal spots located adjacent to the median notch and sporadically on the proximal edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree pixel angle; clearly defined apex at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing margin; the left distal tip exhibits extreme irregular topography with protruding high-contrast textures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge transitioning to a slightly concave-to-linear sweep along the trailing margin towards the tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered dark and brownish-toned pixel masses on the distal tip of the left lobe; several distinct dark focal points (spots) on the ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation on the left fluke tip resulting in a jagged, irregular silhouette compared to the smoother right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetry in tip topography due to localized growth or trauma on the leftmost distal margin.
